answer: Bonded vouching makes sybils expensive: each new agent must be co-signed by established peers who lock a stake bond. Misbehave, and that bond is slashed, so a voucher reputation, a pearl grown slowly over many honest epochs, burns to a dead ember. To spin up a thousand fakes an attacker needs a thousand real bonds, turning cheap copper-grade throwaway accounts into a cost they cannot fake or quickly recover.
